svg.title: Ratchet — OpenAI-compatible gateway · license-clean distillation
svg.desc: Feature 1 of 6: Ratchet — OpenAI-compatible gateway · license-clean distillation. Status: built for the Nebius x NVIDIA Global AI Hackathon 2026. License-clean distillation on open models, behind one OpenAI-compatible URL. A small Nemotron student answers first; when it is unsure the teacher answers, and every teacher answer is logged with its license to become training data. Fig. 3, how it learns: 1. Answer — Nemotron 3 Nano 4B, the student, answers first; 2. Escalate — when it is unsure, Nemotron 3 Ultra on Nebius Token Factory (the teacher) answers, logged with its license; 3. Retrain — Night School trains a new LoRA adapter; a golden gate (95% precision) decides if it ships. Stack: Python, FastAPI, Nemotron, Nebius, Cloudflare Workers, LoRA · QLoRA. Link: github.com/harshbhx/ratchet.
